CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[ObjectDetail] ( @type varchar(50), @id int ) RETURNS @tbl TABLE ( ID int, AssetID bigint, UID uniqueidentifier, AssetTypeID int, AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier, Name nvarchar(max), TextPath nvarchar(max), Description nvarchar(max), ParentID int null, ParentType nvarchar(250), Url nvarchar(2500), TypeID int, [Type] varchar(25), [TypeName] nvarchar(250), [Class] int, IconBackColor varchar(15), IconForeColor varchar(15), IconText varchar(15), Status nvarchar(25) null ) AS BEGIN if @type in ( 'Artifact', 'Attribute', 'Policy', 'ReferenceItem', 'Rule', 'Taxonomy', 'Group', 'Resource', 'Task' ) begin insert into @tbl ( ID, UID, AssetID, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class], Status) SELECT ObjectID, UID, ID, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, DisplayValue, DisplayValue, NULL, null, null, case when Object in ('Task') then Null else dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(ID) end, TypeID, Type, TypeName, AssetTypeClass, NULL FROM AssetDetail where Object = @type and ObjectID = @id end
if @type in ( 'ArtifactType', 'AttributeType', 'PolicyType', 'ReferenceItemType', 'RuleType', 'TaxonomyType', 'TaskType' ) begin insert into @tbl ( ID, AssetTypeUid, [Uid], Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT ObjectID, O.[Uid], O.[Uid], Name, Name, Description, NULL, NULL, case when Object in ('TaskType') then null else turl.[url] end as Url, ObjectID, @type, 'Asset Type', O.[Class] FROM AssetType O cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTypeUrlById(o.id) turl WHERE Object = @type and ObjectID = @id end
if @type = 'Intersect' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, IName.Name, IName.Name, '', NULL, @type, null, O.IntersectTypeID, 'IntersectType', ITN.Name, 0 FROM [Intersect] O INNER JOIN IntersectType T ON O.IntersectTypeID = T.ID and O.ID = @id CROSS APPLY dbo.GetIntersectNames(O.ID) IName CROSS APPLY dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(T.ID) ITN end
if @type = 'IntersectType' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class],[UID]) SELECT ID, T.Name, T.Name, '', NULL, NULL, null, ID, @type, 'Intersect Type', 0, uid FROM IntersectType CROSS APPLY dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(@id) T WHERE ID = @id end
if @type = 'Issue' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, UID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID,O.Uid, '', '', '', NULL, NULL, null, O.IssueTypeID, 'IssueType', T.Name, 0 FROM Issue O INNER JOIN IssueType T ON O.IssueTypeID = T.ID AND O.ID = @id end
if @type = 'IssueType' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, UID,Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, O.uid,O.Name, O.Name, O.Description, NULL, @type, NULL, O.ID, 'IssueType', 'Issue Type', 0 FROM IssueType O WHERE ID = @id end
if @type = 'Report' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, O.Name, O.Name, O.Description, NULL, @type, '#', 0, 'Report', 'Report', 0 FROM Report O WHERE O.ID = @id end
if @type = 'ResponsibilityType' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT ID, O.Name, NULL, Description, NULL, NULL, null, ID, @type, 'Responsibility Type', 0 FROM ResponsibilityType O WHERE ID = @id end
if @type = 'ResourceType' begin insert into @tbl (ID, Name, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) values (@id, 'Resource Type', '#/resources/administration', @id, @type, 'Resource Type',11) end
if @type = 'ShoppingCart' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, Name, Name, NULL, NULL, NULL, dbo.GenerateUrlByTypeName('ShoppingCartType', O.ShoppingCartTypeID, O.ID), O.ID, @type, T.Name, 0 FROM ShoppingCart O inner join ShoppingCartType T on O.ShoppingCartTypeID = T.ID WHERE O.ID = @id end
if @type = 'Tag' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT T.ID, T.Value, T.Value, NULL, NULL, @type, 'tag/' + CAST(T.Uid AS varchar(50)), 0, 'Tag', 'Tag', 0 FROM Tag T WHERE T.ID = @id end
update T set T.IconBackColor = coalesce(S.IconBackColor, '#000000'), T.IconForeColor = coalesce(S.IconForeColor, '#ffffff'), T.IconText = COALESCE(S.IconText, 'leaf') from @tbl T left join AssetType A on A.[Object] = T.[Type] and A.ObjectID = T.TypeID left join AssetTypeStyle S on S.ID = A.ID
RETURN END
changeSet.rollback:

if @type = 'IssueType' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, UID,Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, O.uid,O.Name, O.Name, O.Description, NULL, @type, NULL, O.ID, 'IssueType', 'Issue Type', 0 FROM IssueType O WHERE ID = @id end
if @type = 'Report' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, O.Name, O.Name, O.Description, NULL, @type, '#', 0, 'Report', 'Report', 0 FROM Report O WHERE O.ID = @id end
if @type = 'ResponsibilityType' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT ID, O.Name, NULL, Description, NULL, NULL, null, ID, @type, 'Responsibility Type', 0 FROM ResponsibilityType O WHERE ID = @id end
if @type = 'ResourceType' begin insert into @tbl (ID, Name, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) values (@id, 'Resource Type', '#/resources/administration', @id, @type, 'Resource Type',11) end
if @type = 'ShoppingCart' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, Name, Name, NULL, NULL, NULL, dbo.GenerateUrlByTypeName('ShoppingCartType', O.ShoppingCartTypeID, O.ID), O.ID, @type, T.Name, 0 FROM ShoppingCart O inner join ShoppingCartType T on O.ShoppingCartTypeID = T.ID WHERE O.ID = @id end
if @type = 'Tag' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT T.ID, T.Value, T.Value, NULL, NULL, @type, 'tag/' + CAST(T.Uid AS varchar(50)), 0, 'Tag', 'Tag', 0 FROM Tag T WHERE T.ID = @id end
update T set T.IconBackColor = coalesce(S.IconBackColor, '#000000'), T.IconForeColor = coalesce(S.IconForeColor, '#ffffff'), T.IconText = COALESCE(S.IconText, 'leaf') from @tbl T left join AssetType A on A.[Object] = T.[Type] and A.ObjectID = T.TypeID left join AssetTypeStyle S on S.ID = A.ID
RETURN END
